site.audience: general consumers, creators, parents, and businesses interested in a social media photo and video sharing platform

brief.title: SnapFrame — Capture, Create & Share What You Love
brief.one_liner: SnapFrame is a social media platform that makes it easy to capture, create, and share what you love with the people who matter most.
brief.goal: Serve as the corporate 'About' landing page that introduces the platform's mission, highlights key features, promotes safety tools, showcases creator opportunities, and surfaces the latest news articles.

pages.objective: Introduce the platform's value proposition, highlight features, safety, and creator tools, display recent news articles, and provide download links and comprehensive footer navigation.

navigation.trigger: Try it now button in hero
Safety tools link in safety section
View more link in news section

interactions.trigger: Click hamburger menu icon in header
interactions.expected: Mobile navigation menu opens revealing site links

interactions.trigger: Scroll or swipe through news article cards
interactions.expected: News article cards scroll horizontally to reveal additional articles

expected_content: Sticker Ideas and Tips for Finding the Best Ones
Watch Reels on the Big Screen
data_display.description: A horizontally scrollable list of recent news articles with thumbnail images, category tags, titles, and publication dates.

Comprehensive footer navigation organized into columns: About (Our story, Leadership, Brand), Features (Reels, Stories, DMs, Search & Explore), Safety (Safety tools, Privacy tools, Account security), Community (School Partnerships, Teen Accounts, Anti-Bullying, Parents, Programs), and external links.
